acrobatics.title: Acrobatics
acrobatics.summary: Keeping balance, tumbling, and moving with control.
acrobatics.beginnerTip: Acrobatics is often used when your character tries to stay balanced or move through tight spaces with grace.

animal-handling.title: Animal Handling
animal-handling.beginnerTip: This skill helps when animals are the problem or the solution.

arcana.title: Arcana
arcana.summary: Knowledge of magic, spells, and magical phenomena.
arcana.beginnerTip: Arcana is the classic 'I know weird magic stuff' skill.

athletics.title: Athletics
athletics.summary: Physical feats like climbing, jumping, grappling, and swimming.
athletics.beginnerTip: Athletics is the skill for 'I do it with muscle.'

deception.title: Deception
deception.summary: Lying, bluffing, and disguising the truth.
deception.beginnerTip: Use Deception when your character is trying to convincingly bend the truth.

history.title: History
history.summary: Knowledge of the past, civilizations, and legends.
history.beginnerTip: History helps you know what happened before the current adventure started.

insight.title: Insight
insight.summary: Reading motives, feelings, and hidden intent.
insight.beginnerTip: Insight tells you what someone might really mean, not just what they say.

intimidation.title: Intimidation
intimidation.summary: Scaring others into compliance or hesitation.
intimidation.beginnerTip: Intimidation works best when your character can back up the threat with presence, power, or reputation.

investigation.title: Investigation
investigation.summary: Finding clues, solving puzzles, and analyzing details.
investigation.beginnerTip: Investigation is for careful thinking and looking closely, not just noticing something at a glance.

medicine.title: Medicine
medicine.summary: Understanding injuries, wounds, and basic treatment.
medicine.beginnerTip: Medicine is useful when someone is hurt and you want to know what is wrong before magic or rest comes into play.

nature.title: Nature
nature.summary: Knowledge of plants, animals, weather, and the natural world.
nature.beginnerTip: Nature is the skill for knowing what the wild world is doing and why.

perception.title: Perception
perception.summary: Noticing hidden details, sounds, movement, and danger.
bestFor: Anyone who wants to avoid surprises
perception.beginnerTip: Perception is one of the most rolled skills in the game. High Perception means you notice more before trouble lands on your head.

performance.title: Performance
performance.summary: Playing music, acting, storytelling, and entertaining a crowd.
performance.beginnerTip: Performance is not just music. It can cover any time your character is trying to impress an audience.

persuasion.title: Persuasion
persuasion.summary: Convincing, negotiating, and appealing to others.
persuasion.beginnerTip: Persuasion is the skill for talking people into helping you instead of just doing what you say.

religion.title: Religion
religion.summary: Knowledge of gods, rituals, faiths, and sacred lore.
religion.beginnerTip: Religion covers the stories and rules of gods, cults, holy orders, and sacred traditions.

sleight-of-hand.title: Sleight of Hand
sleight-of-hand.summary: Manual trickery, picking pockets, and delicate hand work.
sleight-of-hand.beginnerTip: This is your 'fast hands and subtle fingers' skill.

stealth.title: Stealth
stealth.beginnerTip: Stealth is how you become a whisper with boots.

survival.title: Survival
survival.summary: Finding your way, tracking, and enduring the wild.
survival.beginnerTip: Survival helps when the world is trying to eat you and you need to keep moving anyway.
